record.paper_title: Open Problems in Quantum Information Theory
record.original_question: Find new counterexamples to maximal output p-norm multiplicativity ν_p(Φ ⊗ Ω) = ν_p(Φ)ν_p(Ω) in which Φ is a random sub-unitary channel with Kraus operators A_k = (1/(d−1)) X^k [[U_k,0],[0,0]], with U_k arbitrary unitaries in M_{d−1}.

evidence.quote: One can choose Ak = 1/(d−1) Xk ( Uk 0 / 0 0 ), k = 0,1,…,d−1. with Uk any set of unitaries in Md−1.
Problem 9. Search for new counterexamples to (24) with Φ a channel with Kraus operators of the form (22).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d \geq 3$ be an integer and let $X \in M_d(\mathbb{C})$ denote the cyclic shift operator defined by $X|j\rangle = |j+1 \bmod d\rangle$ for $j = 0,1,\dots,d-1$. For each choice of unitaries $U_0,U_1,\dots,U_{d-1} \in M_{d-1}(\mathbb{C})$, define operators $A_0,\dots,A_{d-1} \in M_d(\mathbb{C})$ by
$$A_k = \frac{1}{\sqrt{d-1}}\, X^k \begin{pmatrix} U_k & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}, \qquad k = 0,1,\dots,d-1,$$
where the block structure is with respect to the decomposition $\mathbb{C}^d = \mathbb{C}^{d-1} \oplus \mathbb{C}$. One checks that $\sum_k A_k^* A_k \leq I_d$, so $\Phi(\rho) = \sum_{k=0}^{d-1} A_k \rho A_k^*$ defines a sub-unital completely positive trace-non-increasing map (a "sub-unitary channel"). 

For a completely positive map $\Psi$, define the maximal output $p$-norm
$$\nu_p(\Psi) = \sup_{\rho \geq 0,\ \mathrm{tr}\,\rho = 1} \|\Psi(\rho)\|_p,$$
where $\|\cdot\|_p$ is the Schatten $p$-norm.

Problem: Exhibit a choice of $d$, of unitaries $U_0,\dots,U_{d-1} \in M_{d-1}(\mathbb{C})$, of $p > 1$, and of an auxiliary completely positive map $\Omega$, such that the resulting channel $\Phi$ of the above form together with $\Omega$ violates multiplicativity:
$$\nu_p(\Phi \otimes \Omega) > \nu_p(\Phi)\, \nu_p(\Omega).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The general maximal p-norm multiplicativity conjecture was disproved for all p > 1 by Hayden–Winter (2008) using random unitary channels, and earlier for p > 2 by Hayden. However, these counterexamples do not specifically use the structured sub-unitary Kraus form A_k = (d−1)^{-1/2} X^k diag(U_k, 0). No source was found explicitly producing counterexamples within this restricted Kraus family, so the specific question appears unresolved in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Counterexamples to the Maximal p-Norm Multiplicativity Conjecture for all p > 1
status_evidence.snippet: For all p > 1, quantum channels with non-multiplicative maximal output p-norms exist.
status_evidence.claim: General multiplicativity disproved for all p>1, but via random unitary channels rather than the specified sub-unitary Kraus form.

status_evidence.title: The maximum output p-norm of quantum channels is not multiplicative for any p>2
status_evidence.snippet: Random unitary channels yield counterexamples for p > 2.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier counterexamples by Hayden cover p>2 using random unitary channels.
